description.en: Politely asks your open apps to quit, the same as clicking their close button. Apps with unsaved work stop and ask you. Nothing is ever force-quit, and the last session can be reopened.
description.zh-CN: 礼貌地请打开的应用退出，等同于点它们的关闭按钮。有未保存内容的应用会停下来问你，绝不强制关闭；上一次关闭的应用可以一键重新打开。

description.en: How many apps are open and whether a session can be reopened.
description.zh-CN: 现在开着几个应用，能否重新打开上次的应用。

description.en: List the apps that would be asked to quit and the ones that stay.
description.zh-CN: 列出会被关闭和会保留的应用。

description.en: Ask the listed apps to quit.
Open again the apps closed by the last wind-down.
description.zh-CN: 重新打开上一次收工关闭的应用。

keep.description: apps to leave open: names, .exe names or macOS bundle ids, e.g. ["WeChat", "spotify.exe"]

only.description: when set, only these apps are closed

close_folders.description: Windows: also close File Explorer folder windows (never Explorer itself)

wait_seconds.description: how long to wait for apps to finish quitting
